title: Learn to play
subtitle: 6 short missions. Click, try, win. No TCG experience needed.

needItems: A Cyberpunk TCG deck (40–50 cards + 3 Legends)
intro.promise: You lead a Night City crew. You win by controlling jobs: Gigs (dice).
intro.tip: Tip: one Gig = one die. Face values matter for Street Cred, not for the win count.

goal.title: Goal: 7 Gigs
goal.explain: Each turn take a die from your Fixer, roll it, put it in your Gig area. If you start your turn already holding 7 Gig dice → you win.
goal.challenge: Simulate a game: add Gigs up to 7, then “start your turn”.
goal.winLine: 7 Gigs at the start of your turn = victory.
goal.fixerEmpty: Fixer empty — steal the 7th from Rival
goal.diceLeft: {n, plural, one {# die left in Fixer} other {# dice left in Fixer}}

board.title: Zone hunt
board.explain: The playmat has 7 zones. Click the right zone for each question.
board.challenge: Find all 4 asked zones. Wrong clicks are free.

prompts.ask: Where do Units go to fight?
Where do sold cards go for payment (Eddies)?
Where are your 3 special characters at the start?
Where do dice go after you roll them?
prompts.success: Gig area: protect yours, steal theirs.

board.foundAll: Playmat cleared. You know where the crew sits.

cards.title: 4 card types
cards.explain: Flip each card to learn its job. One idea per type.

roles.detail: Exactly 3, start face-down. Flip one per turn (1 €$) or spend any as 1 €$.
Stay on the Field. Attack spent Units or steal Gigs. Can’t attack the turn played (unless Adrenaline).
Pay, resolve, Trash. Some are Quick (reaction timing).
Attaches to a Unit or Legend. Leaves with its host.

cards.allSeen: You know the four roles. Next: turn rhythm.

turn.title: Run a turn
turn.explain: Every turn = Start Phase (fixed order) then Main Phase (your choice).
turn.challenge: Click through each step with “Do this”.

steps.title: 2. Draw
steps.body: Take the top card of your deck.

steps.title: 3. Gain a Gig
steps.body: Take a Fixer die (d20 last), roll it, move it to Gig.

steps.title: 4. Sell (optional, once)
steps.body: Reveal a sellable card, set it face-down = +1 Eddie.

steps.title: 5. Play cards
steps.body: Spend Eddies (or Legends) to play Units, Gear, Programs.

steps.title: 6. Attack
steps.body: Spend a Unit to attack a spent rival Unit or the rival Gig area.

turn.done: Turn complete. Rhythm: Ready → Draw → Gig → then whatever you want.

combat.title: Fight or steal?
combat.explain: Two possible targets. Pick the right move for each setup.

scenarios.setup: Adam Smasher (Power 15) is ready. Rival has Gigs and no spent Units.
scenarios.question: Best way to push for the win?

choices.label: Attack the Gig area → steal 2 Gigs
Attack a ready rival Unit
choices.feedback: You can’t attack ready Units (unless a card says so).

choices.label: Do nothing — too risky
choices.feedback: Allowed, but stealing Gigs is the main win path here.

scenarios.question: How do you clear the Field?

choices.label: Attack Meredith → Power vs Power
choices.feedback: Higher Power wins. Tie = both to Trash.

choices.label: Always ignore Units and only steal
choices.feedback: Sometimes true — but a dangerous spent Unit is often worth removing.

choices.label: Equip Gear onto the Rival
choices.feedback: Gear only equips to your Units / Legends.

scenarios.setup: Rival attacks your Gig area. You have ready Meredith with Blocker.
scenarios.question: Can you react?

choices.label: Spend Meredith (Blocker) to take the hit
choices.feedback: Blocker redirects the attack. Even if you win the fight, no Gig is stolen.

choices.label: Draw 3 as a free reaction
choices.feedback: Not a base rule — only if a card says so.

combat.allClear: Combat and steals: locked in. Last stop: the quiz.

quiz.title: Street exam
quiz.explain: 5 questions. Score 4+ to graduate Night City.

choices.label: As soon as you hit 7 Gigs, even mid-rival turn
choices.feedback: You must start YOUR turn with 7 (except overtime).

choices.label: At the start of your turn if you already have 7 Gigs
When dice faces sum to 50
choices.feedback: That’s Street Cred, not the win condition.

questions.prompt: A Unit was just played. Can it attack?

choices.label: Yes, always
choices.feedback: It has Lag until end of turn.

choices.label: No, unless it has Adrenaline (or similar)
Only if it’s a Legend
choices.feedback: Go Solo Legends are a separate case.

questions.prompt: Power 20 attacking the Gig area steals how many Gigs?

quiz.pass: Diploma unlocked. Dive into full rules whenever you want.

done.title: Welcome to Night City
done.body: You’ve got the basics: Gigs, zones, card types, turns, combat. The rest comes from playing — and the detailed rules.

leave.title: Leave the beginner path?
leave.body: Your progress in the path will be lost and you will have to start over from the beginning.
